title.zh: 【巴西私人银行 Itaú Unibanco 向巴西央行通报其加密交易和托管业务】
title.en: 【巴西私人银行 Itaú Unibanco 向巴西央行通报其加密交易和托管业务】

current_state.zh: Itaú Unibanco 已向巴西央行通报其加密交易和托管业务，成为新数字资产规则下首家完成通报的巴西银行；其支持15种加密资产，现有运营者的通报或申请截止日期为10月30日。
current_state.en: Itaú Unibanco has notified Brazil's central bank of its crypto trading and custody operations, becoming the first Brazilian bank to do so under the new digital-asset rules; it supports 15 cryptoassets, with existing operators facing an October 30 deadline for notifications or applications.

updates.what_changed_en: Itaú Unibanco has notified Brazil's central bank that it will offer crypto trading and custody for 15 assets, including bitcoin, ether, and USDC, under the central bank's authorization framework.

updates.title_zh: 巴西最大私人银行 Itaú Unibanco 成为该国首家通知监管机构的银行
updates.title_en: Brazil’s Largest Private Bank Itaú Unibanco Becomes Country’s First to Notify Re
updates.what_changed_zh: 新报道确认 Itaú Unibanco 于10月27日向巴西央行通报加密交易和托管业务，并称其是巴西首家在新数字资产规则下完成通报的银行，截止日期为10月30日。
updates.what_changed_en: The report confirms Itaú Unibanco notified Brazil's central bank on October 27 and identifies it as the first Brazilian bank to do so under the new digital-asset rules, ahead of the October 30 deadline.
updates.current_state_zh: Itaú Unibanco 已向巴西央行通报其加密交易和托管业务，成为新数字资产规则下首家完成通报的巴西银行；其支持15种加密资产，现有运营者的通报或申请截止日期为10月30日。
updates.current_state_en: Itaú Unibanco has notified Brazil's central bank of its crypto trading and custody operations, becoming the first Brazilian bank to do so under the new digital-asset rules; it supports 15 cryptoassets, with existing operators facing an October 30 deadline for notifications or applications.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Itaú Unibanco became the first Brazilian bank to notify the central bank of its crypto trading and custody operations under the country's new digital-asset rules, ahead of the October 30 deadline for existing operators.
